definition: [ הוֺלֵלָה ] noun feminine madness (on text see below), only plural הֹלֵלוֺת , הוֺלֵלוֺת , and only Ecclesiastes: Eccl 1:17 and I set my heart ( וָאֶתְּנָה לִבִּי ) to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly ( הֹלֵלוֺת וְשִׂכְלוּת ), compare הוֺלֵלוֺת Eccl 2:12 (|| id. ); ׳ וְלָדַעַת רֶשַׁע כֶּסֶל וְהַסִּכְלוּת ה Eccl 7:25 i.e. to know folly to be madness; possibly read חוֺלֵלוּת , compare סִכְלוּת & following; the moral evil of it is specifically recognized in Eccl 9:3 (|| רָע ).
